name: groq_gen_ask
description: Ask a general question or request information. Returns a summarized, information-dense answer.

text.description: The question or text to ask/summarize.

name: gen_website
description: Search the web for one or more site names/queries (comma-separated for multiple) and open the first result for each in the default browser.

website_name.description: Website name(s) or search query to open. Multiple sites can be passed as a comma-separated string, e.g. 'youtube.com, github.com'.

name: ram_usage
description: Get the current system RAM usage percentage.

name: cpu_usage
description: Get the current system CPU usage percentage.

name: gen_sys_analysis
description: Analyze current CPU and RAM usage against historical averages and warn if usage is abnormally high.

name: gen_shutdown
description: Shut down the computer after a short delay.

name: gen_restart
description: Restart the computer after a short delay.

name: gen_exit
description: quit the program after a short delay.
